beats.say: Apple kept the first iPhone a total secret for years.
Development began in the early 2000s, with Steve Jobs ordering the project on 7 November 2004.
The team worked on Project Purple, with Jonathan Ive designing the iconic form factor.
Apple even released an iTunes version containing secret references to an unknown mobile phone.
Steve Jobs finally revealed the iPhone on 9 January 2007. Can you imagine life without it?

meta.alt_title: The secret history of the first iPhone 🍎

meta.comment: Can you imagine a world where the iPhone never existed?
facts: The first iPhone was a top secret project called Project Purple
Apple began development in the early 2000s and Steve Jobs requested the project on 7 November 2004
Jonathan Ive is credited with the form factor of the iPhone
Apple released a version of iTunes that included references to an unknown mobile phone
Steve Jobs announced the first iPhone at the Macworld convention on 9 January 2007
